prompt: Add one piece of outside information to this document's story, and use it to prove a point.
checklist: Brings in a fact that isn't in any document
The fact is accurate and fits the time
Uses the fact to prove a point, not just mention it
model_response: In 1771, Richard Arkwright opened Cromford Mill in Derbyshire, often called the first modern factory (OI). In 1801, Arthur Young, who supported enclosure, wrote that “by nineteen enclosure bills in twenty” the poor “are injured” (Doc 2). Families who lost their land moved to towns to look for work, and mills like Cromford needed workers.

documents.source_text:
Arthur Young was a well-known writer on farming who supported enclosure. In 1801 he wrote:
“. . . the fact is, that by nineteen enclosure bills in twenty they [the poor] are injured, in some grossly injured. . . .”
